preservation_and_static_checks.scope: Local administrative Git/bytes/SHA/JSON/AST-locator/document checks; not science tests, CI, independent numeric validation, or novelty certification.

receipt_policy: A metadata-only direct child commits this receipt. Final remote HEAD and receipt bytes are checked separately to avoid self-hash cycles; every other final file equals its verified payload bytes. The metadata receipt link is completed in that child.
scope: Paper-claim technical preflight, not scientific review, proof creation, numeric reanalysis, SOURCE implementation/execution or research/paper adoption.
